args.title: Freight Blog Summary (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary from blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges are now tracked against weekly diesel price movements rather than fixed schedules.
- Companion analysis: shippers who split volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
